proposals.description: KB entries disagree: KB-001 says a transient sensor glitch (restart_sensor), KB-002 says a sustained spike with low coolant level means a real leak (schedule_service_visit). The spike is sustained and tracks real coolant loss, so it is not a sensor glitch. The last service was a coolant flush on 2026-06-02. A physical inspection for a leak is needed, and the truck should not be run hot in the meantime.
